018
019public class EntropyAmplifierStats extends BaseShipSystemScript {
020        public static String HAS_EA = "has_EA";
021        
022        public static Object KEY_SHIP = new Object();
023        public static Object KEY_TARGET = new Object();
024        
025        //public static float DAM_MULT = 1.5f;
026        public static float DAM_MULT = 1.3f;
027        protected static float RANGE = 1500f;
028        
029        public static Color TEXT_COLOR = new Color(255,55,55,255);
030        
031        public static Color JITTER_COLOR = new Color(255,50,50,75);
032        public static Color JITTER_UNDER_COLOR = new Color(255,100,100,155);
033
034        
035        public static class TargetData {
036                public ShipAPI ship;
037                public ShipAPI target;
038                public EveryFrameCombatPlugin targetEffectPlugin;
039                public float currDamMult;
040                public float elaspedAfterInState;
041                public TargetData(ShipAPI ship, ShipAPI target) {
042                        this.ship = ship;
043                        this.target = target;
044                }
045        }
046        
047        
048        public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, final String id, State state, float effectLevel) {
049                ShipAPI ship = null;
050                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
051                        ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
052                } else {
053                        return;
054                }
055                
056                //DAM_MULT = 1.5f;
057                
058                final String targetDataKey = ship.getId() + "_entropy_target_data";
059                
060                Object targetDataObj = Global.getCombatEngine().getCustomData().get(targetDataKey); 
061                if (state == State.IN && targetDataObj == null) {
062                        ShipAPI target = findTarget(ship);
063                        Global.getCombatEngine().getCustomData().put(targetDataKey, new TargetData(ship, target));
064                        if (target != null) {
065                                if (target.getFluxTracker().showFloaty() || 
066                                                ship == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip() ||
067                                                target == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip()) {
068                                        target.getFluxTracker().showOverloadFloatyIfNeeded("Amplified Entropy!", TEXT_COLOR, 4f, true);
069                                }
070                        }
071                } else if (state == State.IDLE && targetDataObj != null) {
072                        Global.getCombatEngine().getCustomData().remove(targetDataKey);
073                        ((TargetData)targetDataObj).currDamMult = 1f;
074                        targetDataObj = null;
075                }
076                if (targetDataObj == null || ((TargetData) targetDataObj).target == null) return;
077                
078                final TargetData targetData = (TargetData) targetDataObj;
079                targetData.currDamMult = 1f + (DAM_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel;
080                //System.out.println("targetData.currDamMult: " + targetData.currDamMult);
081                if (targetData.targetEffectPlugin == null) {
082                        targetData.targetEffectPlugin = new BaseEveryFrameCombatPlugin() {
083                                @Override
084                                public void advance(float amount, List<InputEventAPI> events) {
085                                        if (Global.getCombatEngine().isPaused()) return;
086                                        if (targetData.target == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip()) { 
087                                                Global.getCombatEngine().maintainStatusForPlayerShip(KEY_TARGET, 
088                                                                targetData.ship.getSystem().getSpecAPI().getIconSpriteName(),
089                                                                targetData.ship.getSystem().getDisplayName(), 
090                                                                "" + (int)((targetData.currDamMult - 1f) * 100f) + "% more damage taken", true);
091                                        }
092                                        
093                                        if (targetData.currDamMult <= 1f || !targetData.ship.isAlive()) {
094                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
095                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getArmorDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
096                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getShieldDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
097                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getEmpDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
098                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getMod(HAS_EA).unmodify();
099                                                Global.getCombatEngine().removePlugin(targetData.targetEffectPlugin);
100                                        } else {
101                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, targetData.currDamMult);
102                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getArmorDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, targetData.currDamMult);
103                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getShieldDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, targetData.currDamMult);
104                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getEmpDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, targetData.currDamMult);
105                                                targetData.target.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getMod(HAS_EA).modifyFlat(id, 1f);
106                                        }
107                                }
108                        };
109                        Global.getCombatEngine().addPlugin(targetData.targetEffectPlugin);
110                }
111                
112                
113                if (effectLevel > 0) {
114                        if (state != State.IN) {
115                                targetData.elaspedAfterInState += Global.getCombatEngine().getElapsedInLastFrame();
116                        }
117                        float shipJitterLevel = 0;
118                        if (state == State.IN) {
119                                shipJitterLevel = effectLevel;
120                        } else {
121                                float durOut = 0.5f;
122                                shipJitterLevel = Math.max(0, durOut - targetData.elaspedAfterInState) / durOut;
123                        }
124                        float targetJitterLevel = effectLevel;
125                        
126                        float maxRangeBonus = 50f;
127                        float jitterRangeBonus = shipJitterLevel * maxRangeBonus;
128                        
129                        Color color = JITTER_COLOR;
130                        if (shipJitterLevel > 0) {
131                                //ship.setJitterUnder(KEY_SHIP, JITTER_UNDER_COLOR, shipJitterLevel, 21, 0f, 3f + jitterRangeBonus);
132                                ship.setJitter(KEY_SHIP, color, shipJitterLevel, 4, 0f, 0 + jitterRangeBonus * 1f);
133                        }
134                        
135                        if (targetJitterLevel > 0) {
136                                //target.setJitterUnder(KEY_TARGET, JITTER_UNDER_COLOR, targetJitterLevel, 5, 0f, 15f);
137                                targetData.target.setJitter(KEY_TARGET, color, targetJitterLevel, 3, 0f, 5f);
138                        }
139                }
140        }
141        
142        
143        public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id) {
144                
145        }
146        
147        protected ShipAPI findTarget(ShipAPI ship) {
148                float range = getMaxRange(ship);
149                boolean player = ship == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip();
150                ShipAPI target = ship.getShipTarget();
151                
152                if (ship.getShipAI() != null && ship.getAIFlags().hasFlag(AIFlags.TARGET_FOR_SHIP_SYSTEM)){
153                        target = (ShipAPI) ship.getAIFlags().getCustom(AIFlags.TARGET_FOR_SHIP_SYSTEM);
154                        if (target != null && target.getOriginalOwner() == ship.getOriginalOwner()) target = null;
155                }
156                
157                if (target != null) {
158                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), target.getLocation());
159                        float radSum = ship.getCollisionRadius() + target.getCollisionRadius();
160                        if (dist > range + radSum) target = null;
161                } else {
162                        if (target == null || target.getOwner() == ship.getOwner()) {
163                                if (player) {
164                                        target = Misc.findClosestShipEnemyOf(ship, ship.getMouseTarget(), HullSize.FRIGATE, range, true);
165                                } else {
166                                        Object test = ship.getAIFlags().getCustom(AIFlags.MANEUVER_TARGET);
167                                        if (test instanceof ShipAPI) {
168                                                target = (ShipAPI) test;
169                                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), target.getLocation());
170                                                float radSum = ship.getCollisionRadius() + target.getCollisionRadius();
171                                                if (dist > range + radSum || target.isFighter()) target = null;
172                                                if (target != null && target.getOriginalOwner() == ship.getOriginalOwner()) target = null;
173                                        }
174                                }
175                        }
176                }
177                
178                if (target != null && target.isFighter()) target = null;
179                if (target == null) {
180                        target = Misc.findClosestShipEnemyOf(ship, ship.getLocation(), HullSize.FRIGATE, range, true);
181                }
182                
183                return target;
184        }
185        
186        
187        public static float getMaxRange(ShipAPI ship) {
188                return ship.getMutableStats().getSystemRangeBonus().computeEffective(RANGE);
189        }
190
191        
192        public StatusData getStatusData(int index, State state, float effectLevel) {
193                if (effectLevel > 0) {
194                        if (index == 0) {
195                                float damMult = 1f + (DAM_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel;
196                                return new StatusData("" + (int)((damMult - 1f) * 100f) + "% more damage to target", false);
197                        }
198                }
199                return null;
200        }
201
202
203        @Override
204        public String getInfoText(ShipSystemAPI system, ShipAPI ship) {
205                if (system.isOutOfAmmo()) return null;
206                if (system.getState() != SystemState.IDLE) return null;
207                
208                ShipAPI target = findTarget(ship);
209                if (target != null && target != ship) {
210                        return "READY";
211                }
212                if ((target == null) && ship.getShipTarget() != null) {
213                        return "OUT OF RANGE";
214                }
215                return "NO TARGET";
216        }
217
218        
219        @Override
220        public boolean isUsable(ShipSystemAPI system, ShipAPI ship) {
221                //if (true) return true;
222                ShipAPI target = findTarget(ship);
223                return target != null && target != ship;
224        }

226}
